The '''EU LCS 2017 Spring Split''' was the first split of the 2017 [[League Championship Series]] season in Europe, organized by Riot Games and held from January 19 to April 23, 2017. The season featured ten teams — eight returning from the [[LCS/Europe/2016/Summer|2016 Summer Split]] and two promoted from the [[LCS/Europe/2017/Spring/Promotion|2017 Spring Promotion]], [[Misfits Gaming]] and [[Origen]]. The split introduced a new group-based format, dividing the league into two groups of five. Matches were played in a Best-of-Three format during the Group Stage, followed by a Single Elimination Best-of-Five Playoffs to determine the European champion and the region’s representative at the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2017|2017 Mid-Season Invitational]].

===Playoffs===
{{#lst:LCS/Europe/Spring/2017/Playoffs|Playoffs}}

==Format==
* Group Stage
**Two groups of five teams each
***Top two teams with the highest Championship Points in 2016 are placed in separate groups
***Remaining 8 teams are distributed to the groups via snake draft
**Each team plays 13 matches.
***Double Round Robin within own group
***Single Round Robin against other group
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
**Top 3 from each group qualifies to the [[LCS/Europe/Spring/2017/Playoffs|Spring Playoffs]]
**Group winners receive playoff byes into the semifinals
**Fifth-place teams play in the [[LCS/Europe/Summer/2017/Promotion|Summer Promotion tournament]]
*Playoffs
**Top 6 from [[LCS/Europe/Spring/2017|Spring Season]]
** Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
* Winner Qualifies for [[Mid_Season_Invitational/2017|Mid-Season Invitational 2017]]
